verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs say it automatically reviews every pull request and generates a structured PR summary. The summary draws on the full codebase so reviewers can quickly grasp the scope and impact of a change, which covers the core of the story. Reviews can also be configured to run automatically. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented file-by-file change walkthrough (only a 'structured summary' is described), confirmation that the summary is posted on every PR by default rather than only reviews, and independent or hands-on corroboration of summary quality.
